title: Task starfleet/refactoring-git abgeschlossen
subtitle: Git/GH utilities refactored into internal/util
body:
Git/GH refactoring completed and deployed:

- Created internal/util/git.go: Git wrapper with comprehensive methods (Clone, Fetch, Push, Pull, Branch, Checkout, Merge, Rebase, Log, Show, Worktree*, Config*, Status, Diff, Add, Commit, etc.)
- Created internal/util/gh.go: GH CLI wrapper for PR operations (View, List, Checks, Comment, Labels, Checkout, Create), Repo/Issue view, Workflow runs, Releases, Auth status
- Created internal/util/utils.go: Shared TrimTrailingNewline helper

Consolidates scattered exec.Command("git", ...) calls from:
- internal/ghpr/git.go (now deprecated)
- internal/wscommit/commands.go
- internal/worktree/run.go
- internal/selfinstall/selfinstall.go
- internal/sop/commands.go
- internal/withclonelock/withclonelock.go
- internal/web/web_test.go (tests)
- internal/sop/reindex_test.go (tests)
- internal/bridged/server_test.go (tests)

Per analysis from 2026-09-07 (Aeon). Tests pass, make all + starfleet-bootstrap + web/timer restart verified.
